correctness.rationale: At ordered gaps a,b,c let L=mu+nu, m=exp(−2mu b), n=exp(−2nu b). With the common factor P²Q² exp(−L(a+c)) removed, the four-moment factors are (1+2m)(1+2n) and (1+2n), and the covariance-pair subtraction is 1+2mn. Thus the kernels are 2(m+n+mn) and 2n(1−m), both positive for interior gaps, with strictly positive difference. Integrating on the 24 ordered simplexes, with the factor 1/16 and combining outer gaps into u, gives precisely the frozen prefactor 3P²Q² and integrals. Dividing by t and dominating by the exponentially integrable kernels yields the exact linear rates and ratio. The simplex integrals t⁴/24 and t⁵/120 and the telegraph factor 2mu b yield the coefficients 3/8 and mu/20. The common covariance PQ exp(−L|t−s|) integrates to the stated variance with independent D_x t. The physical map nu=2 kbar, Q=D_x/kbar, P=4D_kappa/mu=4kappa_0² matches the source's Eqs. (13) and (19) to P/nu; this is not entropy inferred from X alone. Replay: frozen RESULT.md Proof §§1–5 and the reconstruction here. The bound verification file reports finite assertions, not independent/Lean certification; the advertised checks/verify.py was not supplied as a bound artifact and was not executed.
